resources.string: Sign in to see and control your children\'s phones.
The server only keeps your email and which phones you linked, and cannot read the messages between them.
You use it to link each Child phone. The password takes 8 characters or more.
If you forget it, it cannot be recovered: you will have to create another account and link the phones again.
Wrong email or password. Too many tries lock sign-in for a few minutes.
Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
That email already has an account. Sign in with it.
Check the email and that the password has 8 characters or more.
No connection to the server. Check your internet.
On the Child phone open Settings, tap Parent phone and you will see the QR code.
Unlinks all phones and deletes the account
All your children\'s phones are unlinked and this cannot be undone.
To use this phone as the Child phone, sign out.
On the Child phone open Settings, tap Parent phone and scan the code it shows.
Google\'s scanner opens it and sends anonymous usage data to Google. Sophiel does not use the camera.
On the Child phone tap “Show code again” and scan it again.
The code scanner could not open. Check your internet and try again.
Give it a name. It is only seen on this phone.
Not answering. It may be off or without internet.
This phone is no longer paired with your account.
The accessibility service is off on the Child phone
‘Keep protecting always’ is off on the Child phone
That did not work. Try again.
The phone did not answer. %1$s is as it was.
